plugins.name: zcode-claude-style
plugins.description: Claude Code Desktop look for the ZCode desktop client: warm editorial colour cards, Source Serif 4 + Noto Serif SC typography, Deepy whale, and a sidebar settings page. Design tokens ported from dsh-claude-style by Nwflower.

description_i18n.en: Claude Code Desktop look for the ZCode desktop client: warm editorial colour cards, Source Serif 4 + Noto Serif SC typography, Deepy whale, and a sidebar settings page.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 桌面端的 Claude Code 风格皮肤：暖色编辑风色卡、思源宋体排版、Deepy 鲸鱼，以及侧栏设置页。设计令牌移植自 dsh-claude-style（by Nwflower）。
